name: assembly_is_weighed_measured_and_sent
why: ENTRIES Z-D1 and Z-D6. The first questions about a watertight box are «how much does it weigh» and «what box does it fit in», and the second thing you do is send it to the supplier. mass_properties, body_bounding_box and export_step used to refuse an assembly («it is not a part»). A 120x80x10 base in AISI 304 and a 120x80x4 cover in S235JR resting on top of it (y = 7). Measured on 27/9/2026 (prova0089 zd1): the mass of the assembly is EXACTLY the sum of the parts; the component bodies arrive in the space of the PART and have to be brought into the assembly; the STEP of the assembly has one MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP per body, and reading it back opens a modal dialog.
defect_caught: The assembly refused; a mass that does not add up the parts (or adds them twice); a bounding box computed in the space of the parts (the cover at y 0..4 instead of 5..9: 120 x 10 x 80 instead of 120 x 14 x 80); a STEP that loses a component; reading back the assembly STEP, which hangs the bridge.

expect.why: the whole assembly, with the materials of the parts

expect.tolerance_why: the same: the independent check, part by part
expect.why: the mass of the assembly against the sum of its parts read one by one
the base from -5 to 5, the cover from 5 to 9: 14 high. In the space of the parts it would be 10
the bodies of the parts that are not suppressed
